question: The maximum safe dose of lidocaine with adrenaline for local anaesthesia is 3 mg/kg body weight.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is false. Plain lidocaine: maximum 3 mg/kg. Lidocaine WITH adrenaline: maximum 7 mg/kg (adrenaline causes vasoconstriction, slowing systemic absorption). Exceeding these limits risks local anaesthetic systemic toxicity (LAST), which can cause cardiac arrest.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this statement is FALSE. Plain lidocaine has a maximum dose of 3 mg/kg. With adrenaline (which causes local vasoconstriction and slows systemic absorption), the maximum safe dose is 7 mg/kg. Never confuse the two figures.
